observations: Front headlight assembly for a Honda Accord.
The housing is black plastic with a clear lens.
The lens features a horizontal LED daytime running light strip.
The assembly is resting on a piece of cardboard.
A watermark 'JARDON OF GA' is visible across the center of the image.
The image appears to be a screenshot from a mobile device.

claims.evidence: The specific model and variant of the headlight are not visible in the photo.
The brand is not visible in the photo.
The year is not visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock or third-party image rather than the actual item for sale.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual item in a clean, well-lit environment with a handwritten note showing the current date.

risks.risk: The LED daytime running light may be non-functional or the lens may be cracked.
risks.proof: A video showing the headlight being switched on and the LED strip functioning.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken LED strip

risks.risk: The specific model and year (e.g., 2018 vs 2020) may not match the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually found on the housing or the back of the lens).
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-spec model of this year's generation

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the actual item in a clean, well-lit environment.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the model and year.
Video of the headlight being switched on to verify the LED functionality.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
